# page-config

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The Maps browser config of a browser host: provides the MapsBrowserConfigSource host service from the page around the host — the key the real app already sends that page, handed over by the page's chrome as a page input (never read from a server by the host's own code, never stored). A page that supplies none reads as unset, so the map shows its set-up state, whose writes need the computer. Never booted by the desktop.
- Excluded: yes
- Server:
  - Contributes: `host-service:google-maps.browser-config` "google-maps.browser-config"
  - Uses: `integrations/google-maps/browser-config.MapsBrowserConfigSource`

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:END -->
